patch_description: Extend the hierarchical ansatz by adding a second, shared-parameter CRZ ring around the outer perimeter of the tic-tac-toe qubit grid. This adds additional two-qubit phase coupling without increasing the number of unique parameters per block (still shared across the ring). The modification aims to enrich two-qubit correlations with minimal parameter growth, potentially improving validation/test performance and reducing overfitting by leveraging symmetry-based parameter sharing.
